notes: Machine-drafted (AI-assisted) term list; not reviewed. Needs review by a mathematician fluent in Hindi. School-level terms were chosen to match the vocabulary commonly used in Hindi-medium Indian school mathematics (e.g. NCERT Hindi textbooks), but this has not been checked against the textbooks or the Commission for Scientific and Technical Terminology (CSTT) glossaries. University-level terms (category theory in particular) are much less settled, and English terms are often used directly in Hindi-medium higher education.

member.note: 'अवयव' is the usual textbook term for an element of a set.

cardinality.note: Uncertain: the drafter could not confirm an established standard term; a fluent mathematician should supply the term actually used in teaching.

natural-number.note: Indian school textbooks commonly exclude 0 from the natural numbers and call ℕ ∪ {0} 'पूर्ण संख्याएँ' (whole numbers); to be confirmed.

image.note: 'परिसर' is the textbook term for range.

bijective.note: 'द्विभाजी' is less common; to be confirmed.

conjecture.note: 'परिकल्पना' more often means hypothesis. Uncertain: the drafter could not confirm an established standard term; a fluent mathematician should supply the term actually used in teaching.
